summary: Elong Power Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary Elong Power (Beijing) Co., Ltd. entered a three-year energy storage equipment cooperation agreement with a domestic grid-side storage developer. Total procurement value is at least RMB2 billion (about US$300 million), with a first purchase contract of at least RMB300 million (about US$45 million) to be signed January 2027. No equity stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; the agreement is renewable by mutual written consent. This is an ordinary commercial supply contract, not a special situation; watch order conversion into binding contracts and revenue recognition.
